capabilities.description: Prepare and certify interim payment certificates against the BOQ quantities and contract rates, applying retention and performance-security rules, with line-level traceability back to the BOQ.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record
Clause 14.3 Retention: 5% of each Interim Payment Certificate, released 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period.
Clause 4.2 Performance Security: 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount.

capabilities.description: Track time for completion, delay events, and delay-damages accrual against the contract cap, with clause-referenced calculations and alerts.
requirements: Clause 8.2 Time for Completion: 730 days from the Commencement Date.
Clause 8.7 Delay Damages: 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day of delay, capped at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount.
Clause 11.1 Defects Notification Period: 365 days from Taking-Over.

summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project that governs progress claims, delay-damages tracking, QA/ITP records, and a full document register. It uses the uploaded contract excerpt and BOQ as the source of record, enforces the contract's delay-damages, retention, and security clauses, and gives the project team a single traceable ledger from BOQ line through payment certificate and QA evidence.
